correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed both graph-normalization and exact all-order Ldim proof for K_{n,n} minus a size-t matching. Every positive query fixes one row/column, hence Ldim<=n-1; the four-by-four t=3 tree gives an eight-leaf base, and choices of two allowed edges in one row make both branches contain rank-(n-2) residual classes for n>=5, including a full forbidden diagonal. The VC argument uses partial matching supports and Hall degree/two-matching obstructions, with small-order exceptions handled separately. Independent direct minimax enumeration gave (n,t,Ldim)=(2,0,1),(2,1,0),(3,0,2),(3,1,2),(3,2,1),(3,3,1),(4,0,3),(4,3,3),(4,4,2),(5,5,4). The finite check alone does not prove the universal induction.
